gloss: to mock; to ridicule; to deride

definitions.gloss: to mock; to ridicule; to deride
definitions.explanation: To make fun of someone or something in a contemptuous or scornful way. A literary and formal word that implies cruelty or malice in the mockery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{弱者|じゃくしゃ}→弱者：12535_jakusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嘲弄|ちょうろう}した。
⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嘲弄|ちょうろう}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嘲弄|ちょうろう}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧、⟦{不幸|ふこう}→不幸：03595_fukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Misfortunes continued as if fate were mocking him.

notes:
A literary and somewhat formal word. The kanji {嘲|ちょう} means to sneer or mock, and {弄|ろう} means to toy with or trifle with. Together they convey contemptuous, malicious mockery that is harsher than simple teasing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嘲弄|ちょうろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧: a derisive laugh
- {嘲弄|ちょうろう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a mocking attitude
- {嘲弄|ちょうろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be subjected to ridicule
- ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嘲弄|ちょうろう}される: to be mocked by fate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦からかう→からかう：07353_karakau⟧: to tease — lighter, often playful; less malicious
- ⟦{嘲笑|ちょうしょう}→嘲笑：09026_choushou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sneer at, to laugh scornfully — close synonym focused on scornful laughter
- ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a fool of — colloquial; less literary
- {愚弄|ぐろう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to insult, to make a fool of — similarly literary, emphasizing making someone look foolish

USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in literary writing, formal criticism, and intellectual discourse. In everyday conversation, ⟦からかう→からかう：07353_karakau⟧ or ⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ are preferred.
